date.note: The upstream item and the Naxos discographic review agree on 22 March. Commons wikitext says only 1932, but its structured inception supplies 1 January at day precision; that day is unsupported by the session documentation.

processing.value: Internet Archive source is an MP3; Commons holds an Ogg Vorbis conversion and supplies an MP3 derivative. Embedded Vorbis encoder: Lavc58.35.100 libvorbis.

composition.value: Original composition is public domain in ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions.
composition.note: The review identifies Beethoven as 1770–1827. This conclusion does not extend to Schnabel’s sound recording.

recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis).
recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio to Schnabel’s 1932 HMV recording. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.

rights.creditLine: Artur Schnabel, piano. HMV recording, sourced from Internet Archive via Wikimedia Commons. Commons asserts EU public-domain recording status (PD-EU-audio); rights elsewhere are not established.
